episodes.title: Citizen Kane
episodes.description: Michael Aranda examines Citizen Kane and the debate about whether any film can be called the greatest.

episodes.title: Aliens
episodes.description: Examine how James Cameron’s Aliens became a landmark in action, science fiction, and effects filmmaking.

episodes.title: Selma
episodes.description: Examine Ava DuVernay’s Selma and the questions it raises about portraying Martin Luther King Jr. and historical events on film.

episodes.title: Where Are My Children
episodes.description: Examine Lois Weber’s Where Are My Children and its challenging, sometimes contradictory positions in early American cinema.

episodes.title: In the Mood for Love
episodes.description: Explore Wong Kar-wai’s In the Mood for Love through its visual style, emotional effects, and Freudian themes.

episodes.title: Do the Right Thing
episodes.description: Examine Spike Lee’s Do the Right Thing and its portrayal of racial tensions in a Brooklyn neighborhood.

episodes.title: Lost in Translation
episodes.description: Examine Sofia Coppola’s Lost in Translation, its unconventional approach to romantic comedy, and its possible critique of capitalism.

episodes.title: Apocalypse Now
episodes.description: Francis Ford Coppola's "Apocalypse Now" is a different kind of war movie.

episodes.title: Pan’s Labyrinth
episodes.description: Pan's Labyrinth is both a beautifully crafted fairy tale, and harrowing R rated adventure film.

episodes.title: The Limey
episodes.description: Explore Steven Soderbergh’s The Limey, a revenge story about a British criminal investigating his daughter’s death.

episodes.title: Three Colors – Blue
episodes.description: Explore how photography, music, acting, and editing communicate emotion in Krzysztof Kieślowski’s Three Colors: Blue.

episodes.title: The Eagle Huntress
episodes.description: Examine how Otto Bell’s documentary The Eagle Huntress constructs a compelling hero’s journey while raising questions about documentary storytelling.

episodes.title: Moonlight
episodes.description: Moonlight is a hard-edged yet beautifully made story about a black American dealing with his sexuality in a sometimes unforgiving and violent world.

episodes.title: Beasts of No Nation
episodes.description: Examine the filmmaking in Cary Fukunaga’s Beasts of No Nation, a story about a child forced to become a soldier.

episodes.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
episodes.description: On the surface, 2001 tells the story of human history as related to technology and some kind of alien influence.
